Reviews praise fast, reliable event creation from text, images, and screenshots, with parents and volunteers highlighting smoother coordination for rehearsals, family events, and shifting schedules. Users value quick imports into shared Google Calendars and note the team’s responsiveness to feedback. Several applaud the simplicity and accuracy, calling it a long‑awaited fix for paper, PDF, and image invites. Suggestions include a Chrome extension for one‑click adds and attaching the source image to entries. One review notes it works best for multiple events and bulk scheduling.
